motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Ugh, I'm falling apart... I'm sorry... I'm so sorry!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: Bad things need to be beaten!

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: B-Beer?! That's a beverage that only grown-ups can drink, I have no interest in it! I've brought my own sour plum drink. It's enough for me...

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Please take care of me… I'm not feeling guilty!

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: I didn't find any meteorites, but I got everything that you want.

motions.name: login
motions.line: Huh, here already? Crap, my thermos is still open.

motions.name: login
motions.line: Huh, here already? Crap, my thermos is still open.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: I wear my gas mask when I head out... The air is really bad outside, right? If my circuits get contaminated, I won't grow any taller.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: The sun, the moon, the stars, and tin foil... They're all shiny, and so are the Commander's buttons. Um, may I take a closer look at your buttons?

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: You're so cool, Commander. Will I ever grow to be this cool?

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Um, would you like some sour plum drink?

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: I hope I'll find a piece of meteorite on this trip.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: You and me, Commander? Hmm... <>I hear this is a very solemn oath. I'm not sure if I'm good enough for this. <>But I'll do my best, because you're the stars to me!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: I want to be of more help to you, so I've been reading more books lately. But sci-fi is so much more exciting than non-fiction. Do you like sci-fi, Commander?
